notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Client activity, finished uploads, payments and reminders about your plan.
notifications.markedAllRead: All notifications are marked as read.
notifications.loadFailed: Check your connection and try again.
notifications.actionFailed: That didn't go through. Try again.
notifications.emptyBody: When a client opens or downloads a gallery, or an upload finishes, you'll see it here.

gallery_downloaded.bodyCap: {client} used the whole download allowance of “{gallery}”. The link is now closed.

gallery_expiring.body: The link to “{gallery}” closes on {date}. Extend it from the gallery if your client needs more time.

gallery_closed.title: Gallery closed
gallery_closed.body: The link to “{gallery}” reached its end date and is now closed.

gallery_ready.title: Gallery ready to share
gallery_ready.body: {files, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} processed in “{gallery}”.

payment_approved.title: Payment approved

allowance_warning.title: {percent, select, 100 {Delivery allowance used up} other {{percent}% of your allowance used}}
